Definition: Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Mizpah = "watchtower"; 1) a place in Gilead north of Jabbok and location of Laban's cairn; 2) a place in Gilead south of Jabbok; site unknown; 3) a place near Mount Hermon; 4) an old sacred place in Benjamin
